page_title: PAR 2-3 STR | Paris FC v Strasbourg 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Francois Letexier has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' The expression of the referee Francois Letexier is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Mike Penders (Strasbourg) is shown a yellow card.
90+4' 2 - 3 Goal! Alimani Gory (Paris FC) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
90+2' The referee has issued a yellow card to Valentin Barco (Strasbourg).
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' It's a yellow card for Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg).
90' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Francois Letexier to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Strasbourg players can finally celebrate.
90' Wait! Referee Francois Letexier has indicated he is going to review the Strasbourg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
89' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Nhoa Sangui will be replaced by Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC).
87' 1 - 3 Simply glorious! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) wonderfully times his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the top right corner!
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) will replace Diego Moreira.
83' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) commits a rough foul. Francois Letexier stops the game and makes a call.
81' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) bravely launches himself at a cross from Ilan Kebbal and gives Mike Penders no chance with a close-range bullet header into the right of the goal. 1:2.
79' The substitution has been made. Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) has replaced Adama Camara.
78' 0 - 2 Guela Doue (Strasbourg) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
78' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Paris FC comes to nothing.
74' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
73' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathis Amougou (Strasbourg) replacing Samir El Mourabet.
73' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is punished with the yellow card.
71' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' A substitution has been made. Moses Simon is replaced by Nouha Dicko (Paris FC).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hamari Traore departs the field of play to be replaced by Thibault De Smet (Paris FC).
65' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
61' Liam Rosenior has decided to make a change. Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) replaces Kendry Paez.
61' The referee allows time for a substitution. Martial Godo will be replaced by Guela Doue (Strasbourg).
61' Here's the change. Joaquin Panichelli leaves the pitch and Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
60' CHANCE! Moses Simon (Paris FC) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
59' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes a short free kick.
58' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
55' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

49' Paris FC are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Stephane Gilli decided to make a change. Willem Geubbels is replaced by Alimani Gory (Paris FC).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
43' The cross into the penalty area from Martial Godo (Strasbourg) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
39' Paris FC quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
39' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) brings an opponent down and Francois Letexier interrupts the game. A free kick has been awarded to Paris FC.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Paris FC.
35' Paris FC take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Moses Simon (Paris FC) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. Paris FC have a corner.
29' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) connects with a loose ball in the box, but sends his first-time shot miles over the bar.
27' 0 - 1 Goooooal! Diego Moreira beats his man and slings in a cross towards Kendry Paez (Strasbourg), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the right post from close in. 0:1.
25' A player from Paris FC brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Martial Godo (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Adama Camara (Paris FC) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
7' The Strasbourg players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Mike Penders sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
1' An attempted cross from Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
Paris FC will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Francois Letexier.
